integrity: The package contains a complete analytic proof and a standalone finite exact-arithmetic checker. Finite checks are not a substitute for the infinite-time proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only exact instantaneous flip coefficient -1 and reciprocal even-integer delays; the sharp moment classification is for scalar linear feedback. Broader historical-priority and independent mathematical validation remain outstanding.
title: Geometric occupation and intermittent moments at an even-base pantograph flip resonance
